title: Curvature measures and volume preserving flows in h-convex geometry
summary: In this paper, we introduce a concept of modified curvature measures for h-convex domains in hyperbolic space and prove a shifted version of the generalized Alexandrov theorem, which characterizes geodesic balls in hyperbolic space via modified curvature measures. This result generalizes the classical work of Kohlmann (1998). We further investigate a volume-preserving shifted $α$-Gauss curvature flow for strictly h-convex hypersurfaces in hyperbolic space and prove that for any $α>0$ the solution exists for all time and converges smoothly to a geodesic sphere.
